author: rApq
content:
GOAL was to fix the CommentAdded hub-cache parse error (cosmetic: truncates reverse-index reads of agent event logs; writes always fine). 

ATTEMPT: backed up .crosslink + the 0.8.0 binary, then cargo install --path /Users/maxine/code/forecast/crosslink/crosslink (-> v0.9.0-beta.1, source HEAD 7854152b). New binary DID fix reads.

BLOCKER: v0.9 treats the live v2 hub (crosslink/hub) as legacy READ-ONLY and refuses mutations until 'migrate hub-v3'. But the remote already hosts a STALE v3 hub frozen at the 2026-06-12 migration snapshot (283 issues, max #283) — missing ALL work since: stage-1 increments after 6/12, G1, post-G1, and the entire Stage-2 tree (#320-#334). The v2 crosslink/hub (tip 1ab286e2) is the TRUE complete source of truth (334 issues). Adopting v3 = silent loss of ~50 issues of visibility.

RESOLUTION: rolled the binary back to 0.8.0 (restored from backup), restored the v2 .crosslink cache from backup. Verified all Stage-2 work intact (#320-#333, DAG, umbrella). Back to the known-good state that ran all week. The cosmetic read bug returns (documented).

DEFERRED (separate deliberate task): a PROPER v3 migration must migrate from the CURRENT v2 tip, not the June-12 snapshot. Requires clearing/superseding the stale remote v3 refs (crosslink/agents/*, crosslink/checkpoint, crosslink/meta) then a fresh 'migrate hub-v3' from 1ab286e2, ideally coordinated so no v2-binary writes race it. NOT a quick fix; do when ready to also finalize (--finalize --yes-delete-v2) in one coordinated pass. Backup retained at scratchpad/crosslink-backup-20260619.
